faqs.answer: A light agent handles quick one-off tasks with no memory. GAIA carries context across tasks, connects to 50+ tools, and acts before you ask.
faqs.question: How is GAIA different from OpenAI Dots?

faqs.answer: GAIA offers a free tier, and Pro is a flat ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month. Self-hosted GAIA has no per-task metering at all.
faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost?

faqs.answer: Start with Gmail and Calendar for context, then add Slack or your task tool. GAIA's memory starts building from the first connected day.
faqs.question: How do I switch to GAIA?

50+ integrations with email, calendar, tasks, and chat

metaDescription: Need more than a light agent? GAIA is an open-source OpenAI Dots alternative with memory, 50+ tools, and proactive action.
metaTitle: Best OpenAI Dots Alternative: Full AI OS
migrationSteps: Note which Dots tasks keep needing context Dots cannot see
Connect Gmail and Calendar to give GAIA that missing context
Rebuild your most repeated Dots request as a GAIA workflow
Let GAIA run it proactively instead of prompting each time
name: OpenAI Dots
painPoints: Dots starts fresh every time, with no memory between tasks
Limited to what the chat surface exposes, no deep tool connections
Cannot reach your inbox or calendar to act with context
Closed and still evolving, so capabilities shift under you
Quick answers only: follow-through is your job
tagline: The fast lane is great until you need memory.
whyPeopleLook: Dots is perfect until the task needs context. Users hit the wall when a quick request depends on an email thread, a calendar event, or last week's decision, none of which Dots can see. People searching for an OpenAI Dots alternative want the same speed with memory attached: an assistant that remembers, connects to tools, and finishes the job.
